scientific_scope: development-only shared conditional goal-difference model P(D|T,X) for exact T>=7. This component cannot solve exact-tail q(k|T>=7), cannot generate a unified matrix and cannot create exact-score permission.

source.name: eatpizzanot/soccer-dataset
source.identity_gate: same C071 threshold-8 strict-PIT eligible identities

population: eligible completed pre-2024 matches with realized exact total T>=7

estimand.equivalent_parameterization: H=(T+D)/2; model P(H=h | T=t,X) on h=0..t and map D=2H-T
estimand.support_guarantee: binomial support H=0..T implies every output D has correct T/D parity and maps to nonnegative integer H,A

baseline.family: exact-T pooled Dirichlet-smoothed empirical P(H|T) from training rows only
baseline.support: H=0..T for each exact T; unseen training T falls back to uniform legal support
baseline.reason: high-tail league-by-T cells are too sparse for a stable league-specific primary baseline

candidate.family: cross-T shared conditional binomial goal-allocation model
candidate.p_model: SimpleImputer(median) + StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(C=0.1, solver=lbfgs, max_iter=2000, class_weight=null, random_state=0)
candidate.fit_likelihood: exact binomial likelihood implemented by expanding each match into T Bernoulli goal-allocation trials, H home-goal successes and T-H away-goal failures
candidate.feature_provenance: first 12 are exactly the frozen C073-A score-history feature representation; exact_total is the one structural conditioning feature

fold_rule: for each test calendar year, fit baseline and candidate only on eligible completed tail rows with calendar_year strictly earlier than the test year; features are strict-PIT snapshots using outcomes available before target kickoff

draw_diagnostics: actual even-T draw recall when D=0 is candidate Top1

all_required: coverage gate passes before effect interpretation
paired bootstrap 90% upper bound for dLogLoss < 0
at least 4/5 chronological year folds have dLogLoss < 0
all candidate support cells satisfy parity/integer score mapping
frozen_pass_gate.decision: SCIENTIFIC_COMPONENT_PASS_DEVELOPMENT_ONLY only if every required gate passes; otherwise FAIL_PARK; STOP_COVERAGE if coverage fails

stopping_rule: If FAIL, do not tune C, add interactions, change feature subsets, fit separate T=7/8/9 models, add draw/1-1 boosts or alter folds/gates on these scored OOS labels as a repair of C077-A.
